description: Search the fighter roster by name, nationality or promotion. Cursor paginated. Returns identity fields plus `roster` (the promotion's own published roster status: active, off_roster or retired); use get_fighter for the full record. With org="ufc", roster_status narrows to fighters the UFC lists as active, no longer lists on its roster (off_roster) or lists as retired.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 code or country name.

org.description: Only fighters who have fought for this promotion.

roster_status.description: Needs org="ufc" (the promotion that publishes its roster): active = listed on its roster, off_roster = no longer listed, retired = listed as retired. As published by the promotion.

name: search_fighters
title: Search the roster
